verdict.rationale: Token2's core offering is FIDO2/PIV hardware keys. Its software layer is open source and runs entirely on the user's own machine: the fido2-manage CLI/GUI built on libfido2, open-source desktop and mobile companion apps, and browser tools that compute TOTP locally with no server round-trip. That gives users a no-vendor-server setup, but 'self-hosting' maps only loosely onto a hardware product. Missing for 10: any documented self-hosted server or deployment guide (e.g., a self-hostable backend or the web tools packaged for local hosting), open firmware for the keys themselves, and independent corroboration of running the stack without Token2 infrastructure.
